info.title: Insurer obligation proposals (P4-M5-B2)
info.description: Explicit nonposting insurer-obligation proposals linked to issued invoice lines. Approval is an informational finance decision; it does not modify an invoice, payment, receivable, or patient balance.

get.description: Requires insurance_obligations.view plus invoice and patient view authorization in the active tenant. Paginated; approval status is proposed or approved. No responsibility assignment or posting is created.

200.description: Paginated proposals in the standard API envelope.

403.description: Missing exact permission or patient/invoice access.

post.description: Requires insurance_obligations.propose plus invoice and patient view authorization. The invoice must be issued or partially paid; the proposed amount must be positive, exact, same-currency, and no greater than the referenced invoice-line gross charge. Never inferred from estimates or insurer observations.

source_provenance.example: Finance proposal supported by the recorded insurer decision.

201.description: Proposed obligation created; no posting or patient-balance change.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an identical proposal.

403.description: Missing exact permission or patient/invoice access.

422.description: Lineage, amount, status, or currency does not satisfy proposal rules.

get.summary: Retrieve an obligation proposal and history
get.description: Requires insurance_obligations.view plus invoice and patient view authorization. Returns proposal and optional immutable approval history.

200.description: Proposal and history in the standard API envelope.

403.description: Missing exact permission or patient/invoice access.

404.description: Obligation is outside the active tenant.

post.description: Requires insurance_obligations.approve plus invoice and patient view authorization. Appends approval history for the exact proposed amount. This does not create an allocation, payment, receivable, or patient liability.

approval_reason.example: Finance reviewed the cited documentation and approves this proposal.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an identical approval.

403.description: Missing exact permission or patient/invoice access.

404.description: Obligation or related invoice is outside the active tenant.

409.description: Already approved, invoice changed, or idempotency conflict.

TenantHeader.name: X-Tenant-Id
TenantHeader.description: Optional tenant selector; active tenant membership and object authorization remain required.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID command key for idempotent proposal or approval.
